resource.name: Fusion Studio — official product
resource.creator: Blackmagic Design
resource.description: Standalone compositing application, version 21.1.1 released October 2, 2026. Adds Krokodove tools, OpenPBR and OCIO 2.5/ACES 2.0 workflows. Mac requires Apple Silicon and macOS 15+. Python 2 is no longer supported; compatible license required.

history.name: Fusion Studio
history.summary: Fixes sTrace, Console shortcuts, dual-screen layouts and OGraf caching, and improves Magic Mask performance.
changes: Addressed issue with deselecting combined text fields.
Addressed issue with copy and select all shortcuts in Console.
Addressed issue with with dual screen layouts.
Addressed OGraf caching and path relinking issues.
OGraf animation improvements for duration aware sizing and outro.

history.name: Fusion Studio
history.summary: Adds Krokodove shapes/3D, OpenPBR, DJI D-Gamut2/D-Log2, GoPro Log, Leica L-Log and Vivo transforms.
changes: Adds Krokodove shapes/3D, OpenPBR, DJI D-Gamut2/D-Log2, GoPro Log, Leica L-Log and Vivo transforms.
Improves MultiText alignment and font previews; adds viewer-line lens calibration, OGraf animation controls and multi-template DRFX macro editing.
Adds external camera-track imports, reference-frame tools, deep-image previews, hard-mix blending, HTJ2K EXR input/output and DNG correction bypass.
Supports OCIO 2.5 and ACES 2.0, richer variable syntax, log-conversion alpha handling, matte objects and motion blur in deep Renderer3D, faster deep rendering and monitoring.
Drops Python 2. Mac now requires Apple Silicon and macOS 15. Includes stability improvements; see full notes for exact hardware and driver requirements.

history.name: Fusion Studio
history.summary: Exact patch identified; Windows long-path support and stability improvements.
changes: Windows handling of exceptionally long paths is corrected.
The Paint inspector’s settings tab receives a fix.
